title: Report Defaults
description: Durable default settings for repeated Zendesk-first reporting runs.

timeframe_days.description: Default reporting window, in days, when the user does not specify one.

items.description: Name of a section that should usually appear in repeated reports.

include_sections.description: Sections that should usually be included in recurring backlog or trend outputs.

next_actions_count.description: Default number of next actions the report should include.

comparison_mode.description: Whether the report should compare current results against another period or a prior run.

include_example_tickets.description: Whether representative tickets should usually be included when they improve the report.
